artifact: PHASE 4A §4-§6 - runtime value model, result states, numeric representation

valueTypes.RATIO: { value: Rational } dimensionless, distinct from NUMBER

notModeled.DURATION: no runtime representation; a reference declaring DURATION/PERIOD fails its type contract explicitly
notModeled.STRING_ENUM: not required by the IR beyond ENTITY_SET

serializedForm: exact decimal string when the value terminates, else exact fraction 'a/b'; never a JS float; BigInt never crosses the boundary

numericRepresentation.decision: exact rational arithmetic (BigInt numerator / positive BigInt denominator, always reduced)
numericRepresentation.literalConversion: IR numbers are converted through their shortest decimal string (0.125 -> 1/8), never through binary float arithmetic
numericRepresentation.rounding: only at rendering (toFixed, round-half-even); never during evaluation

resultStates.EXECUTABLE: all required values known; operation deterministically evaluated
resultStates.NEEDS_INPUT: legal semantics known; a runtime fact is absent (missingInputs enumerated)
resultStates.UNSUPPORTED: the IR contains a construct the runtime cannot evaluate (Phase-3 UNSUPPORTED node, unmodeled temporal window, schedule gap)
resultStates.AMBIGUOUS: the trusted semantic layer itself is unresolved (AMBIGUOUS/MISSING_CONTEXT/CONFLICTED definition or rule)
resultStates.ERROR: deterministic internal failure: unit mismatch, currency mismatch, division by zero, cycle, malformed node, type-contract violation

precedenceNote: ERROR > UNSUPPORTED > AMBIGUOUS > NEEDS_INPUT > EXECUTABLE when operands disagree; exceptions: AND/OR short-circuit over NEEDS_INPUT only; MAX/MIN record bounds as metadata under NEEDS_INPUT
